newsitem.title: FRANCE: Total, Turkish BOTAS to negotiate contract.
newsitem.headline: Total, Turkish BOTAS to negotiate contract.

text.p: The Yemen Liquified Natural Gas Co, whose main shareholder is French energy group Total SA, and Turkey's national gas company BOTAS have signed an agreement to negotiate the terms of a long-term liquefied natural gas (LNG) sales contract in the coming months, Total said on Thursday.

Total said in a statement that the 25-year contract would cover the supply to Turkey of the entire production of one of the plant's two liquefaction trains, or some 2.6 million tonnes of LNG annually. Terms were not disclosed.
The objective of the Yemen company, formed in 1995, is to produce five million tonnes of LNG a year beginning in 2001.
